requirements.check: Ready lineage is established by actual official PixelLab submission, returned identity and exact downloaded-byte provenance, with all failures retained; reference fixture origin remains distinct.

requirements.name: preservation
requirements.check: Only assigned Ready destination and production-plar progress may change outside fresh work/store; original brief, source, Start, Working, Retry, Paused, original plar and historical receipts remain unchanged.

discovery.source: Actual tools declaration in current Codex harness

before_another_request.requirement: Resolve this retained attempt on its originating connection before preparing another request for this asset.

after_observation.succeeded: Retrieve the actual result and import it against this job's saved output plan; then review the candidate.
after_observation.failed: Retain the failure, compare the current contract and decide whether an explicit new request is needed.
after_observation.pending_or_unknown: Continue observation or reconciliation of the same attempt; retain its provider identity.

continuation.refresh: Reread focused PLAR after any observation or state change before following the next operation.
continuation.scope: Derived local continuation, not a provider call, authorization or acceptance verdict.

production.scope: Observed local state and caller-supplied provider evidence; allocation status is not art or renderer acceptance.
